_comment: Machine-readable statement of what this project HAS and HAS NOT demonstrated. Updated in the same commit as any change to the claim state. Pattern credited to Vishwateja-123/hiver-support-agent (MIT); content and implementation are our own. See docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.

tests._note: 3 skipped are superseded candidate-state taxonomy tests, retained and marked rather than deleted. 18 real-data tests skip without the corpus; 1 safety-probe test skips without the golden candidate file.

dataset.note: Reconstruction code was written against the DOCUMENTED TWCS schema. Those assumptions are unverified and may require changes once the real file is inspected.
dataset.brand_decision_status: Corrected re-decision 2026-09-10 after the reply_classify defect. Lexicographic tie-break, criterion 1 (usable_grounding_evidence_pairs 31,241 vs 20,076). Original decision preserved as superseded.

system.classifier_model: tfidf_logreg (chosen on operational grounds, not dev score)
system._llm_note: IMPLEMENTED AND VALIDATED against Groq. Still NOT validated against OpenRouter, OmniRoute or Anthropic - no key was available for those.
system._security_note: Lexical rule retained and unchanged; a semantic detector (local MiniLM, no network, no vendor) is unioned with it so the composite can only ADD a detection. Measured on 24 independent descriptions of 7 security categories: lexical 2/24, composite 24/24, with 0/10 false positives on benign traffic. Routing escalates on security across every intent and confidence value, proven exhaustively.

evaluation.classifier_dev_labels: WEAK SUPERVISION - rule-recovery scores, NOT accuracy
evaluation._metric_note: No metric of real classification quality exists. Dev figures measure agreement with deterministic labelling functions that also produced the training labels, and manual inspection found the labeller wrong on real cases. True accuracy is unknown until the hand-labelled golden set exists.
evaluation._agent_note: The agent runs end-to-end on real data but is NOT evaluated. No labels exist, so the demo rates (80% auto-handle, 20% escalate) describe BEHAVIOUR, not correctness. The golden set is the blocking dependency.
evaluation._golden_note: 200 candidates exist and are explicitly UNLABELED. A candidate set is NOT a golden set: golden_set_created stays false until a human has annotated it and scripts/freeze_golden.py has validated and locked it. The freeze refuses a partial set (verified: exits 1 with 0 labels), and no training, classifier or agent module may import the golden package.
evaluation._retraction_note: One pass-1 annotation (101236__101237) was entered before the annotation guide had been read and was withdrawn by the annotator. The original record is preserved in annotations.jsonl for audit; its label is excluded everywhere and the example returns to the queue. Retracted labels can never reach gold: load_gold and the freeze both read effective annotations.
evaluation._assisted_note: 160 candidates carry a PROVISIONAL model suggestion (MODEL_GENERATED, separate file, separate type); 40 are blind per SPEC 9.2 so anchoring bias stays measurable. A suggestion is never gold: it becomes a label only when a human accepts or corrects it, and the review_action plus the suggestion shown are recorded on every label. These will NOT be 200 independently-classified-from-scratch labels and must never be described as such.
evaluation._evaluation_note: Evaluated on all 200 golden examples (reports/golden_eval/). DISCLOSURE: 159/160 assisted labels are identical to the Llama pre-annotation, accepted at a median 0.4s, so all-200 metrics measure agreement with human-accepted model pre-annotation; the 40 blind labels are reported separately. Judge is groq qwen/qwen3.8-27b after the Claude judge failed on OpenRouter HTTP 402 (zero credits). Judge-human agreement UNMEASURED: no human reply-quality ratings exist.
evaluation._risk_coverage_note: reports/golden_eval/risk_coverage.{json,md,png}: 4 systems x recorded confidence scores x 21 thresholds, all-200 and blind-40. No threshold selected on the gold set. Confidence scores recorded by an offline cache-only reproduction whose 800 decisions and all metrics are identical to the original run.
evaluation._failure_analysis_note: reports/golden_eval/failure_analysis.md, from committed artifacts only; every count recomputed by scripts/failure_analysis.py. No fix implemented. Top modes: human-action-required messages auto-handled (28/29 unsafe, policy), context misses (25/31, rule), deflection via a shared regex gap (11/88), over-escalation (66/125, single-turn design), intent errors (114/200).

llm.pricing_source: console.groq.com/docs/models (provider docs; the API response carries no cost field)
llm.note: VALIDATED: a real Groq model answered real AppleSupport messages end-to-end through the agent pipeline. Two defects were found that no constructed fixture could have surfaced - a missing User-Agent blocked by Cloudflare, and a citation-format mismatch. Both fixed. The known lexical security-gate defect was CONFIRMED against a real model and deliberately left unfixed.

ideas_adopted_with_citation: blind annotation subset to measure anchoring bias (AshrafAhmed9)
golden ids excluded from retrieval corpus (ChetanChavan45)

honest_summary: An end-to-end support resolution agent runs on real AppleSupport data and can now run through a real LLM provider (OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) behind an abstraction, with caching, retries, cost accounting and secret redaction - though no real API call has yet been made. A 200-example golden CANDIDATE set has been drawn reproducibly from the untouched test pool under a protocol frozen beforehand; every example is explicitly UNLABELED. The agent is still NOT evaluated, because evaluation requires human labels that do not exist yet. A behavioural smoke test on the deterministic generator exposed a real safety defect: the security gate is lexical and missed a described account takeover that used none of its trigger words.

milestone.completed: 6 + real-LLM validation - golden candidates (unlabelled), provider layer proven against a live Groq endpoint
milestone.next: human annotation of the 200 candidates, then the evaluation harness
milestone.blocked_on: human annotation - no metric of agent quality is possible before it

brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.status: RESOLVED 2026-09-10 by approved lexicographic tie-break; AppleSupport re-decided on corrected evidence. Original preserved as superseded historical evidence.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.what_happened: Two defects were fixed in reply_classify: stem-only verb patterns missed inflected forms ('restarting'), and the English gate rejected terse navigation instructions, systematically discarding the most actionable replies.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.impact: Re-running the brand analysis raises actionable_resolution_rate by ~0.092 on average and usable_grounding_evidence_pairs by ~1487 per brand. Brands passing the pre-registered filters rise from 5 to 27. AmazonHelp and AppleSupport then tie at rubric score 0.7246 (exact to 6dp); the current winner is decided by sort order.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.action_taken: Frozen decision (AppleSupport) left UNCHANGED in brand_profiles.json / brand_decision.json / brand_selection.md. New evidence preserved separately as reports/brand_profiles_reclassified.json and brand_decision_reclassified.json.
brand_selection_affected_by_classifier_f.decision_required: Keep AppleSupport, switch to AmazonHelp, or add a principled tiebreak.

release_audit.retrieval_confidence_gate: inert on gold (0 of 123 below threshold; unreachable by construction)
